newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) KEEPS GASOLINE PRICES STEADY.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) KEEPS GASOLINE PRICES STEADY.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will keep gasoline prices unchanged, effective on Thursday June 5.
Transport diesel and heating oil prices will be reduced by 0.70 drachmas per litre and 1.10 drachmas per litre respectively, DEP said.

The price adjustments come after lower world gasoline prices, down by $3.0 per metric tonne, lower diesel prices, down by $4.9 per metric tonne, lower heating oil prices, down by $6.10 per metric tonne and a firmer dollar/drachma exchange rate, up 3.40 drachmas per $, it said.
